item.text:
Subject: Request to Combine Two Orders into One Delivery

Dear [Supplier Name],

I hope you’re well. We recently placed two orders, [Order Number 1] and [Order Number 2], and would like to ask whether they could be combined into a single delivery.

Could you please confirm if this is possible and let us know whether it would affect the delivery schedule or shipping charges? We understand that combining the orders may not reduce the cost.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
